title: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands

game.title: Prince of Persia: The Forgotten Sands
game.blurb: Acrobatic action-adventure with time powers, set around Solomon's Palace and its sand army, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2010-05-18. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Fandom level page names, as there is no Steam achievement list.

chapters.title: The Ramparts and the Fortress
chapters.summary: The first levels: the Ramparts, the Fortress, the first Palace Courtyard, the Treasure Vault and the Stables.

chapters.title: The Works, the Gates and the Prison
chapters.summary: The Works, the second Palace Courtyard, the Fortress Gates, the Prison and the Sewer.

chapters.title: The Baths and the Royal Quarters
chapters.summary: The Baths, the Royal Chambers, the Observatory, the Throne Room, the Terrace and the Rooftop Gardens.

chapters.title: The Aqueducts and Rekem
chapters.summary: The Aqueducts, Solomon's Tomb, the Ruins of Rekem, Rekem's Throne Room, the Sacred Fountain and the Rekem Reservoir.

chapters.title: Solomon's Hall and the Finale
chapters.summary: Solomon's Hall, the King's Tower, the Palace and the Final Climb. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Powers and Upgrades
chapters.summary: The Power of Time, Flow and Memory, and the upgrade menu powers such as Whirlwind, Stone Armor, Ice Blast and Trail of Flame.

attribution: Steam: no achievement list available for this game (see notes)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Prince_of_Persia:_The_Forgotten_Sands
Fandom (princeofpersia.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://princeofpersia.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_of_Persia:_The_Forgotten_Sands
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub). Only "Controls" (about 1,300 characters) and "Table of Contents" (about 660) exist; its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Characters, Upgrades, sarcophagi and achievements subpages are linked but not created, so nothing was used. princeofpersia.fandom.com answers the API, with about 153 linked pages, including 25 "(Forgotten Sands Level)" pages and "The Final Climb"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Chapters group these levels in the order they are linked on the Fandom game page; that order was not checked against the game, and the split into chapters is a judgement call. RAWG has separate entries for the Wii, PSP and DS versions, which are different games; this entry is the PC, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 one. Steam app 33320 returns an empty achievement schema, so steam=None. RAWG lists a playtime of only 2 hours, which looks low.
